App Privacy Policy

This privacy policy describes how data is handled by the Doppel Threat Intelligence app for ServiceNow. It is provided for transparency in line with data privacy and regulatory standards.

1. What data is collected

  • Threat alerts from the customer's Doppel account: alert ID, the reported value (URL, domain, email address, phone number, social media profile), brand, product, platform, queue and entity state, severity, score, notes, tags, timestamps, a link to Doppel Vision, a screenshot link, and the latest entries of the alert's audit history.
  • Details Doppel collected about the reported value, for example domain registration and hosting data, social media profile details, or marketplace listing details.
  • For dark web alerts, the data Doppel reports for the finding, which can include leaked email addresses, credentials and partial payment card data.
  • Names or email addresses of people who worked on an alert in Doppel (for example assignee, uploader, audit history).
  • Configuration data: Doppel API credentials (API key and user API key, or OAuth client ID and client secret), an access token, and import settings.

2. When data is sent to Doppel

Data is sent from ServiceNow to Doppel only when:

  • the app imports alerts on its schedule, or tests the connection (read requests);
  • an analyst runs Threat Lookup on an observable (the observable value is sent to Doppel);
  • a playbook uses the Doppel actions to look up, create or update an alert (the value, brand, state changes, comments or tags provided in the playbook are sent to Doppel).

3. How the data is used

  • To create and update threat intelligence observables, indicators, indicator metadata and threat lookup results in ServiceNow.
  • To keep indicators in line with Doppel's alert lifecycle (for example deactivating taken-down threats).
  • To give analysts Doppel's verdict and a link to the alert in Doppel Vision.
  • To authenticate requests to the Doppel API.

4. Whether the data is shared with other parties

Data is exchanged only between the customer's ServiceNow instance and the customer's Doppel account. It is not shared with any other third party.

5. How the data is transferred, stored and secured

  • All communication with Doppel uses HTTPS.
  • Credentials and access tokens are stored in encrypted fields in ServiceNow and are never shown after entry.
  • Imported data is stored in the customer's ServiceNow instance and is subject to the instance's access controls; the app's data is visible only to users with the app's roles.
  • Indicators are deactivated rather than deleted, so history is kept until the customer removes it.
  • Authentication with Doppel uses API keys or OAuth 2.0 client credentials.

This policy may be updated to reflect changes in data handling or regulatory requirements. Customers are advised to review it regularly.
